title: [BUG] API Error (Connection error.)
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ X] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [ ] Other: <!-- specify -->
- Claude CLI version: latest
- Operating System: Windows 11
- Terminal:  WARP

## Bug Description
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)

    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)

    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Start Claude Code
2. Craft a brilliant prompt
3. Watch your tokens get wasted on a broken api 

## Expected Behavior
I expect that when I pay for a service, that the service doesn't fail unexpectedly so frequently that it becomes expected.

## Actual Behavior
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)
  ⎿  API Error (Connection error.) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
    ⎿  TypeError (fetch failed)

Results in hour long hangs on prompts, slows development to a crawl, and sometimes results in funky results.

## Additional Context
The only context needed here is that this has been going on for far too long now, and we're reported it daily here, but it doesn't appear from this end that any progress is being made, or communicated.  Simply instead, every day we deal with it again and again, and these bug reports continue to get closed as if it's resolved.

ITS NOT RESOLVED.  STOP CLOSING THESE REPORTS AS IF IT IS

top_comments.body: I'm a user but I fixed a similar issue with the authorization token by typing /login and resigning in.

top_comments.author: adrienthebo
top_comments.body: > I'm a user but I fixed a similar issue with the authorization token by typing /login and resigning in. I just tried this but that didn't resolve the issue. This issue only appears when I have colima running. ``` ❯ colima version colima version 0.8.1 git commit: 96598cc5b64e5e9e1e64891642b91edc8ac49d16 runtime: docker arch: aarch64 client: v28.3.0 server: v27.4.0 ``` I ran a tcpdump and I can see that a TLS session is getting negotiated and shortly after I get a TCP RST.
